dish.title: Egg Foo Young with Mushroom Gravy and Steamed Rice
dish.description: Fluffy pan-fried omelette patties packed with bean sprouts, shiitake mushrooms, carrot, and scallions, served over steamed rice with a glossy brown soy gravy.

recipe_version.title: Egg Foo Young with Mushroom Gravy and Steamed Rice
recipe_version.description: Fluffy pan-fried omelette patties packed with bean sprouts, shiitake mushrooms, carrot, and scallions, served over steamed rice with a glossy brown soy gravy.

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp vegetables, the rest for the patties

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Rinse and drain the bean sprouts, slice the shiitakes, cut the carrot into matchsticks, and slice the scallions. Whisk the cornstarch into 1 cup water with the soy sauce and sugar for the gravy.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Soften the vegetables
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a 12-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high. Cook the shiitakes and carrot 3 minutes, add the bean sprouts and scallion whites for 1 minute, and transfer to a bowl to cool slightly. Wipe the skillet.

steps.title: Mix and pan-fry the patties
steps.body: Beat the eggs with the salt and white pepper and stir in the vegetables. Heat 1 tbsp oil in the skillet over medium. Ladle in 1/2-cup portions, 3 at a time, nudging stray sprouts back toward the center. Pan-fry until golden and set at the edges, about 2 minutes, flip, and cook 2 minutes more. Repeat with the rest, adding oil as needed, to make 8 patties.

steps.title: Make the gravy
steps.body: Whisk the gravy mixture again and bring it to a simmer in a 1-quart saucepan over medium, whisking, until glossy and thick, about 2 minutes. Stir in the sesame oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Set two patties over rice on each plate, spoon the gravy over, and scatter the scallion greens.
